csv_project_name: Engineering Service for Public Works Office Additions
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Aransas Pass is accepting Request for Qualifications for architectural, and engineering services related to the planning and design of a new Public Works office building. The City is seeking a qualified architectural/engineering firm with extensive experience, skill, and success in designing municipal facility improvements. The city anticipates a contracted Scope of Work which will include: - Evaluation of Existing Conditions - Cost Estimating at each design phase - Production of computer-generated renderings - Design Development - Construction Documents - Permitting - Bid-Phase Assistance - Value Engineering as necessary - Construction Administration - Project Closeout - Warranty-Phase Assistance
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Value Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
